plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'Music AA-T Degree - instrumentalist (Full Time, Fall Start)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published July 15, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7452/PublishedPdf), GE Pattern: Cal-GETC, Start Term: Fall. Total Units 61 = 16+15+14+16 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). Performance courses: students are expected to take a minimum of 8 units from MUP 310, 311, 320, 321, 323, 324, 330, 331, 340, or 341; which courses are used depends on the student's concentration. Large performance ensemble courses have an enrollment limitation: the ability to play at least one instrument commonly used in the ensemble. Scheduling: MUFHL 310, 400, and 410 are offered in the fall; MUFHL 401 and 411 are offered in the spring. Most CSUs require an entry piano proficiency demonstration. B.A./B.M. programs often require a music history course like MUFHL 310; students should discuss B.A./B.M. degree options with Music department faculty or staff. Students can substitute ESLW 340 for ENGL C1000/C1000H. The CSU system requires American Institutions coursework; students can complete this requirement at ARC before transferring. See ASSIST.ORG for transfer requirements of the destination institution. Students with a cumulative GPA of 3.2 or better who complete 15 or more units of Honors coursework earn an Honors Transfer Certificate.
